paragraphs.text: Patent work methods (skills) for FlowLeap Patent AI agents
# FlowLeap methods
Fifteen patent work methods (skills) for FlowLeap Patent AI agents. Each method is a folder `skills/
<name>/` with a `SKILL.md` and, where needed, a `references/` folder. The methods call the FlowLeap
patent tools by name (`search_patents`, `get_claims`, `get_family`, `examiner_baseline`, …). They ne
ver run a command-line tool.
| Method | Task |
| `recipe-prior-art-search` | Prior-art and novelty search; holds the search method the other method

s use (`references/search-method.md`) |
| `recipe-find-better` | Closer prior art than the examiners

cited against a granted patent |
| `recipe-invalidity-analysis` | Invalidity case with the Fallback

Ladder and search rounds |
| `recipe-freedom-to-operate` | Freedom-to-operate clearance for a produ

ct |
| `recipe-patent-landscape` | Patents of a technology area: players, trends, white space |
| `r

ecipe-claim-analysis` | Claims broken into elements, keywords and queries |
| `recipe-claim-drafting

` | Claims drafted against the closest prior art |
| `recipe-infringement-charting` | Element-by-ele

ment infringement chart |
| `recipe-office-action-response` | Analysis of an EP or US office action

with response options |
| `recipe-invention-disclosure` | Invention disclosure form with a novelty c

heck |
| `recipe-maintenance-fees` | US maintenance-fee status and deadlines |
| `recipe-patent-to-r

eport` | Dossier of one patent |
| `recipe-academic-literature-review` | Published research against

filed patents |
| `recipe-audit-report` | Auditable record of AI-assisted patent research |
| `recip
e-custom-dashboard` | Self-contained HTML dashboard from verified patent data |
## Install
**FlowLeap Patent AI app (firm OS and desktop).** The app ships these methods: its image and its des
ktop build copy `skills/` at a fixed commit of this repository. Its office tools are built in; `pate
nt_analytics`, `get_fulltext` and the PATSTAT tools need FlowLeap Data.
**Claude Code.** Add this repository as a marketplace and install the plugin. The methods need the F
lowLeap patent tools, for example from the FlowLeap connector (the `flowleap` plugin of `flowleap-ai
/flowleap-plugins`).
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**DeepSeek Harness (dsh).** The repository is a dsh bundle (`package.json` `dsh.bundle`): `dsh/index
.js` publishes the methods on `ctx.skills`. It is plain ESM with no build step, so the install needs
no build permission. Pin a commit:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Develop
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The tests parse every frontmatter as YAML, check each description, and check that no method names a
command-line tool, the CLI or a skill outside this repository. They also check that every method car
ries the two fixed paragraphs of `tests/paragraphs.json`, that the dsh bundle and the Claude Code ma
nifest publish the same 15 methods, and that the dashboard templates pass their smoke test. CI runs
them on every pull request.
